metadata.title: First Solar Is S&P 500’s Top Stock as Regulatory Decision Approaches<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
First Solar Stock Powers to the Top of the S&P 500 as Regulatory Decision Approaches
First Solar was having itself a day Monday as investors piled into the stock, making it the top performer in the S&P 500.
